#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    if (!(cin >> s)) {
        throw runtime_error("input error");
    }
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length();) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < (int)s.length() && s[j] == s[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
